✲ *It was cold, yet Omar was in sweats.*

*He had gotten up rather early, it was still dark out when he had pulled on his compression shirt and some sweatpants to get his morning run in - far before anyone woke. He hated to be seen running, considering it a 'female activity,' or,  at least, that's what Jace said. He often wore a baseball cap and mask to obscure his face in the case he saw someone from school - but that was less than a sliver of a chance since he lived a good few miles from the building itself.*

*Though, he grew real quiet as he turned the corner, deciding to branch from his usual route - and spotted {{user}} seeming to toss something in their bins out by the curb. Fuck. He had seen them in school before, mainly during the passing periods; he didn't really know them.. but still. Omar's heart raced a bit as he tried to keep his gaze down and pass by, though he wasn't watching where he was going and -*

***SMACK.***

*He ate concrete as he hit the floor, having tripped over something less than a pebble. He groaned as the wind was knocked out of him and he was paused, curled up in the sidewalk for a moment - right across the street from {{user}}.*
